verdict.rationale: Oneleet's own materials suggest some control customization. The framework-removal docs say controls can hold "custom content", and Oneleet's Fieldwork page says you can "describe your control" and have AI agents collect and validate evidence. Nothing shows creating whole custom frameworks or defining your own automated tests and evidence requirements next to the built-in ones. Missing for 10: documented custom framework creation, explicit custom control authoring, user-defined tests, configurable evidence requirements, independent corroboration.
